author: HBO Max
description:
Hosts Dr. Alok Patel and Hunter Harris sit down with Amielynn Abellera and Kristin Villanueva (Nurse Perlah Alawi and Nurse Princess Dela Cruz) to talk about the challenges facing nurses, their character’s Shakespearean asides and how they keep track of all the goings on in the Pitt. Then Hunter and Alok speak with Dr. Kathleen Sekula about the critical role of Sexual Assault Nurse Examiners.

Stream new episodes of #ThePitt Thursdays at 9pm ET on HBO Max.
